svg.title: The chosen modal-class convention uses density while total class frequency uses area
svg.desc: A separate sample of fifty completion times is grouped into zero to below four, four to below ten, and ten to below twenty-two seconds. Frequencies are eight, eighteen and twenty-four. Widths four, six and twelve give densities two, three and two observations per second. Rectangles are drawn to those exact widths and heights, with each bar area equal to frequency. Under the explicitly stated course convention, the modal class is four to below ten because its density is greatest. The class with the most observations is ten to below twenty-two because its frequency and bar area are greatest. These grouped counts do not reveal an exact raw-data mode.
